1	# DeepSeek-V2: Efficient MoE Language Model with Multi-Head Latent Attention
     2	
     3	## Source
     4	https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04434
     5	
     6	## Model Overview
     7	
     8	DeepSeek-V2 is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 236B total parameters, of which only 21B are activated per token. It supports a 128K-token context length. The model was pretrained on 8.1T tokens from a high-quality, multi-source corpus with extended Chinese data. Post-training includes Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on 1.5M conversational sessions and Reinforcement Learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).
     9	
    10	Compared with DeepSeek 67B (a dense predecessor), DeepSeek-V2 delivers:
    11	- **42.5% reduction** in training costs
    12	- **93.3% reduction** in KV cache size
    13	- **5.76× higher** maximum generation throughput
    14	
    15	## Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA)
    16	
    17	Conventional Multi-Head Attention (MHA) stores full key-value pairs per head per token, creating a KV cache bottleneck during autoregressive generation. Alternatives like Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Multi-Query Attention (MQA) reduce cache but sacrifice performance.
    18	
    19	MLA introduces **low-rank key-value joint compression**: instead of caching full K and V vectors, MLA compresses them into a compact latent vector $\mathbf{c}_t^{KV}$, which is cached during inference. Full keys, values, and a decoupled RoPE-based positional key are reconstructed on-the-fly via learned projection matrices. This yields **better performance than MHA** while requiring dramatically less cache.
    20	
    21	![Attention mechanism comparison: MHA vs GQA vs MQA vs MLA](./assets/figure_2.jpg)
    22	
    23	## DeepSeekMoE Architecture
    24	
    25	The FFN layers use the DeepSeekMoE design with two expert types:
    26	- **Shared experts** ($N_s$): always activated, capture common knowledge
    27	- **Routed experts** ($N_r$): sparsely activated via a top-$K_r$ router
    28	
    29	Fine-grained expert segmentation increases specialization potential. Device-limited routing constrains each token to experts on at most $M$ devices, reducing cross-node communication. Auxiliary losses enforce load balance across experts and devices, and a token-dropping strategy during training prevents expert overflow without affecting inference.
    30	
    31	![DeepSeek-V2 architecture diagram](./assets/figure_1.jpg)
    32	
    33	## Performance Benchmarks
    34	
    35	DeepSeek-V2 achieves top-tier MMLU performance among open-source models while activating far fewer parameters than competitors.
    36	
    37	| Model | Activated Params (B) | MMLU Score |
    38	|---|---|---|
    39	| DeepSeek-V2 | 21 | 78.5 |
    40	| LLaMA 3 70B | 70 | 77.0 |
    41	| Mixtral 8x22B | 39 | 77.6 |
    42	| Qwen1.5 72B | 72 | 75.6 |
    43	| DeepSeek 67B | 67 | 73.0 |
    44	| LLaMA 2 70B | 70 | 69.0 |
    45	| Mixtral 8x7B | 13 | 70.6 |
    46	| LLaMA 3 8B | 8 | 65.0 |
    47	
    48	![MMLU vs activated parameters](./assets/figure_3.jpg)
    49	
    50	## Alignment and Chat Evaluation
    51	
    52	After SFT and GRPO-based RL, DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) achieves strong results on open-ended conversation benchmarks:
    53	
    54	| Benchmark | DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) |
    55	|---|---|
    56	| AlpacaEval 2.0 (length-controlled win rate) | 38.9% |
    57	| MT-Bench (overall) | 8.97 |
    58	| AlignBench (overall, Chinese) | 7.91 |
    59	
    60	On AlignBench (Chinese), DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) outperforms all open-source models and most closed-source models, demonstrating exceptional multilingual alignment quality.
    61	
    62	## Key Findings
    63	
    64	- **MLA achieves superior performance to MHA** while reducing KV cache by 93.3%, making it a strictly better alternative to GQA/MQA for inference efficiency.
    65	- **DeepSeekMoE with fine-grained experts and shared expert isolation** enables training a 236B-parameter model at 42.5% lower cost than a 67B dense model.
    66	- **Only 21B activated parameters** are needed to match or exceed 70B-class dense models (LLaMA 3 70B, Qwen1.5 72B) on MMLU.
    67	- **5.76× throughput improvement** over DeepSeek 67B makes DeepSeek-V2 practical for large-scale deployment.
    68	- **DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) is the strongest open-source chat model in Chinese** and competitive with closed-source systems in English open-ended evaluation.

    51	
    52	# PPTX Manipulation Skill
    53	
    54	## Overview
    55	
    56	This skill enables programmatic creation, editing, and manipulation of Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations using the **python-pptx** library. Create professional slides with text, shapes, images, charts, and tables without manual editing.
    57	
    58	## How to Use
    59	
    60	1. Describe the presentation you want to create or modify
    61	2. Provide content, data, or images to include
    62	3. I'll generate python-pptx code and execute it
    63	
    64	**Example prompts:**
    65	- "Create a 10-slide pitch deck from this outline"
    66	- "Add a chart to slide 3 with this data"
    67	- "Extract all text from this presentation"
    68	- "Generate slides from this markdown content"
    69	
    70	## Domain Knowledge
    71	
    72	### python-pptx Fundamentals
    73	
    74	```python
    75	from pptx import Presentation
    76	from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
    77	from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
    78	from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
    79	
    80	# Create new presentation
    81	prs = Presentation()
    82	
    83	# Or open existing
    84	prs = Presentation('existing.pptx')
    85	```
    86	
    87	### Presentation Structure
    88	```
    89	Presentation
    90	├── slide_layouts (predefined layouts)
    91	├── slides (individual slides)
    92	│   ├── shapes (text, images, charts)
    93	│   │   ├── text_frame (paragraphs)
    94	│   │   └── table (rows, cells)
    95	│   └── placeholders (title, content)
    96	└── slide_masters (templates)
    97	```
    98	
    99	### Slide Layouts
   100	```python
   101	# Common layout indices (may vary by template)
   102	TITLE_SLIDE = 0
   103	TITLE_CONTENT = 1
   104	SECTION_HEADER = 2
   105	TWO_CONTENT = 3
   106	COMPARISON = 4
   107	TITLE_ONLY = 5
   108	BLANK = 6
   109	
   110	# Add slide with layout
   111	slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[TITLE_CONTENT]
   112	slide = prs.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
   113	```
   114	
   115	### Adding Content
   116	
   117	#### Title Slide
   118	```python
   119	slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[0]  # Title slide
   120	slide = prs.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)
   121	
   122	title = slide.shapes.title
   123	subtitle = slide.placeholders[1]
   124	
   125	title.text = "Quarterly Report"
   126	subtitle.text = "Q4 2024 Performance Review"
   127	```
   128	
   129	#### Text Content
   130	```python
   131	# Using placeholder
   132	body = slide.placeholders[1]
   133	tf = body.text_frame
   134	tf.text = "First bullet point"
   135	
   136	# Add more paragraphs
   137	p = tf.add_paragraph()
   138	p.text = "Second bullet point"
   139	p.level = 0
   140	
   141	p = tf.add_paragraph()
   142	p.text = "Sub-bullet"
   143	p.level = 1
   144	```
   145	
   146	#### Text Box
   147	```python
   148	from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
   149	
   150	left = Inches(1)
   151	top = Inches(2)
   152	width = Inches(4)
   153	height = Inches(1)
   154	
   155	txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
   156	tf = txBox.text_frame
   157	
   158	p = tf.paragraphs[0]
   159	p.text = "Custom text box"
   160	p.font.bold = True
   161	p.font.size = Pt(18)
   162	```
   163	
   164	#### Shapes
   165	```python
   166	from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
   167	
   168	# Rectangle
   169	shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
   170	    MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE,
   171	    Inches(1), Inches(2),  # left, top
   172	    Inches(3), Inches(1.5) # width, height
   173	)
   174	shape.text = "Rectangle with text"

   176	# Common shapes:
   177	# MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, ROUNDED_RECTANGLE

   180	```
   181	
   182	#### Images
   183	```python
   184	# Add image
   185	slide.shapes.add_picture(
   186	    'image.png',
   187	    Inches(1), Inches(2),  # position
   188	    width=Inches(4)        # auto height

   190	
   191	# Or specify both dimensions
   192	slide.shapes.add_picture(

   194	    Inches(8), Inches(0.5),

   197	```
   198	
   199	### Tables
   200	```python
   201	# Create table
   202	rows, cols = 4, 3
   203	left = Inches(1)
   204	top = Inches(2)
   205	width = Inches(8)
   206	height = Inches(2)
   207	
   208	table = slide.shapes.add_table(rows, cols, left, top, width, height).table
   209	
   210	# Set column widths
   211	table.columns[0].width = Inches(2)
   212	table.columns[1].width = Inches(3)
   213	table.columns[2].width = Inches(3)
   214	
   215	# Add headers
   216	headers = ['Product', 'Q3 Sales', 'Q4 Sales']
   217	for i, header in enumerate(headers):
   218	    cell = table.cell(0, i)
   219	    cell.text = header
   220	    cell.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
   221	
   222	# Add data
   223	data = [
   224	    ['Widget A', '$10,000', '$12,500'],
   225	    ['Widget B', '$8,000', '$9,200'],
   226	    ['Widget C', '$15,000', '$18,000'],
   227	]
   228	for row_idx, row_data in enumerate(data, 1):
   229	    for col_idx, value in enumerate(row_data):
   230	        table.cell(row_idx, col_idx).text = value
   231	```
   232	
   233	### Charts
   234	```python
   235	from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
   236	from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE
   237

   256	### Formatting
   257	
   258	#### Text Formatting
   259	```python
   260	from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
   261	
   262	run = p.runs[0]
   263	run.font.name = 'Arial'
   264	run.font.size = Pt(24)
   265	run.font.bold = True

   267	run.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x00, 0x66, 0xCC)

   269	
   270	#### Shape Fill & Line
   271	```python
   272	from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
   273	
   274	shape.fill.solid()
   275	shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x00, 0x80, 0x00)
   276	
   277	shape.line.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x00, 0x00, 0x00)
   278	shape.line.width = Pt(2)
   279	```
   280	
   281	#### Paragraph Alignment
   282	```python
   283	from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
   284	
   285	p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER  # LEFT, RIGHT, JUSTIFY
   286	```
   287	
   288	## Best Practices
   289	
   290	1. **Use Templates**: Start with a .pptx template for consistent branding
   291	2. **Layout First**: Plan slide structure before coding
   292	3. **Reuse Slide Masters**: Maintain consistency across presentations
   293	4. **Optimize Images**: Compress images before adding
   294	5. **Test Output**: Always verify generated presentations
   295	
   296	## Common Patterns
   297	
   298	### Slide Deck Generator
   299	```python
   300	def create_deck(title, slides_content):
   301	    prs = Presentation()
   302	    
   303	    # Title slide
   304	    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
   305	    slide.shapes.title.text = title
   306	    
   307	    # Content slides
   308	    for slide_data in slides_content:
   309	        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[1])
   310	        slide.shapes.title.text = slide_data['title']
   311	        
   312	        body = slide.placeholders[1]
   313	        tf = body.text_frame
   314	        for i, point in enumerate(slide_data['points']):
   315	            if i == 0:
   316	                tf.text = point
   317	            else:
   318	                p = tf.add_paragraph()
   319	                p.text = point
   320	    
   321	    return prs
   322	```
   323	
   324	### Data-Driven Charts
   325	```python
   326	def add_bar_chart(slide, title, categories, values):
   327	    from pptx.chart.data import CategoryChartData
   328	    from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE
   329	    
   330	    chart_data = CategoryChartData()
   331	    chart_data.categories = categories
   332	    chart_data.add_series('Values', values)
   333	    
   334	    chart = slide.shapes.add_chart(
   335	        XL_CHART_TYPE.BAR_CLUSTERED,
   336	        Inches(1), Inches(2),
   337	        Inches(8), Inches(4),
   338	        chart_data
   339	    ).chart
   340	    
   341	    chart.chart_title.text_frame.text = title
   342	    return chart
   343	```

   345	## Examples
   346	
   347	### Example 1: Create a Pitch Deck
   348	```python

   379	slide.shapes.title.text = "Market Opportunity: $50B by 2028"

   398	
   399	### Example 2: Report with Data Table
   400	```python
   401	from pptx import Presentation
   402	from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
   403	
   404	prs = Presentation()
   405	
   406	# Title slide
   407	slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
   408	slide.shapes.title.text = "Sales Performance Report"
   409	slide.placeholders[1].text = "Q4 2024"
   410	
   411	# Data slide
   412	slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[5])
   413	slide.shapes.title.text = "Regional Performance"
   414	
   415	# Create table
   416	table = slide.shapes.add_table(5, 4, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.5), Inches(9), Inches(4)).table
   417	
   418	# Headers
   419	headers = ['Region', 'Revenue', 'Growth', 'Target']
   420	for i, h in enumerate(headers):
   421	    table.cell(0, i).text = h
   422	    table.cell(0, i).text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.bold = True
   423	
   424	# Data
   425	data = [
   426	    ['North America', '$5.2M', '+15%', 'Met'],
   427	    ['Europe', '$3.8M', '+12%', 'Met'],
   428	    ['Asia Pacific', '$2.9M', '+28%', 'Exceeded'],
   429	    ['Latin America', '$1.1M', '+8%', 'Below'],
   430	]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Generate a 9-slide 16:9 technical presentation for DeepSeek-V2.
Follows the pptx-manipulation skill and task_input.json structure.
"""

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE, XL_LEGEND_POSITION
from pptx.chart.data import XyChartData, CategoryChartData
from pptx.enum.dml import MSO_THEME_COLOR
import os

# ── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
OUTPUT_PATH = "/app/output/final_deck.pptx"
ASSETS_DIR = "/app/benchmark/assets"
SLIDE_WIDTH = Inches(13.333)
SLIDE_HEIGHT = Inches(7.5)

# Color palette: dark tech theme
COLOR_BG = RGBColor(0x0D, 0x11, 0x17)          # near-black background
COLOR_ACCENT = RGBColor(0x00, 0xC8, 0xFF)      # cyan accent
COLOR_ACCENT2 = RGBColor(0xFF, 0x6B, 0x35)     # orange accent
COLOR_TEXT = RGBColor(0xE8, 0xEC, 0xEF)        # off-white
COLOR_TEXT_DIM = RGBColor(0x8A, 0x92, 0x9E)    # muted gray
COLOR_CARD_BG = RGBColor(0x18, 0x1E, 0x26)     # card background
COLOR_HIGHLIGHT = RGBColor(0x2A, 0xD4, 0x7A)   # green highlight

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def set_slide_bg(slide, color):
    background = slide.background
    fill = background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color

def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=Pt(14),
                font_color=COLOR_TEXT, bold=False, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
                font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = font_size
    p.font.color.rgb = font_color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = align
    return txBox

def add_bullet_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, bullets,
                       font_size=Pt(16), font_color=COLOR_TEXT,
                       bullet_color=COLOR_ACCENT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, bullet in enumerate(bullets):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = bullet
        p.font.size = font_size
        p.font.color.rgb = font_color
        p.font.name = font_name
        p.space_after = Pt(10)
        p.level = 0
    return txBox

def add_card(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG,
             line_color=COLOR_ACCENT, line_width=Pt(1)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height
    )
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.color.rgb = line_color
    shape.line.width = line_width
    # Remove shadow
    shape.shadow.inherit = False
    return shape

def add_metric_box(slide, left, top, width, height, value, label,
                   value_color=COLOR_ACCENT, label_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM):
    card = add_card(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG,
                    line_color=COLOR_ACCENT, line_width=Pt(1))
    # Value
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top + Inches(0.15), width, Inches(0.6))
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = value
    p.font.size = Pt(28)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = value_color
    p.font.name = "Calibri"
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    # Label
    txBox2 = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top + Inches(0.65), width, Inches(0.4))
    tf2 = txBox2.text_frame
    p2 = tf2.paragraphs[0]
    p2.text = label
    p2.font.size = Pt(12)
    p2.font.color.rgb = label_color
    p2.font.name = "Calibri"
    p2.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

# ── Build Presentation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = SLIDE_WIDTH
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_HEIGHT

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 1: Title
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])  # Blank
set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

# Accent bar at top
bar = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, SLIDE_WIDTH, Inches(0.08))
bar.fill.solid()
bar.fill.fore_color.rgb = COLOR_ACCENT
bar.line.fill.background()

# Title
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(2.0), Inches(11.7), Inches(1.2),
            "DeepSeek-V2: A Strong, Economical, and Efficient MoE Language Model",
            font_size=Pt(40), bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
            font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

# Subtitle stats
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(3.3), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.6),
            "236B total parameters  ·  21B activated per token  ·  128K context length",
            font_size=Pt(20), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
            font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

# Paper attribution
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(4.2), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.5),
            "arXiv:2405.04434  ·  DeepSeek-AI",
            font_size=Pt(14), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
            font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

# Key stats row
add_metric_box(slide, Inches(1.5), Inches(5.2), Inches(3.0), Inches(1.1),
               "42.5%", "Training cost reduction vs. DeepSeek 67B",
               value_color=COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
add_metric_box(slide, Inches(5.1), Inches(5.2), Inches(3.0), Inches(1.1),
               "93.3%", "KV cache reduction via MLA",
               value_color=COLOR_ACCENT)
add_metric_box(slide, Inches(8.7), Inches(5.2), Inches(3.0), Inches(1.1),
               "5.76×", "Generation throughput improvement",
               value_color=COLOR_ACCENT2)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 2: Motivation & Challenge
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "The LLM Scaling Dilemma: Performance vs. Training Cost and Inference Speed",
            font_size=Pt(32), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.1), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "Larger models yield better intelligence, but at prohibitive cost",
            font_size=Pt(16), font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

# Three challenge cards
challenges = [
    ("Training Cost", "Dense parameter scaling makes pre-training budgets explode. A 70B-class dense model requires massive GPU clusters and weeks of training time.", COLOR_ACCENT2),
    ("KV Cache Bottleneck", "Standard Multi-Head Attention stores full key-value pairs per head per token, creating memory pressure that cripples long-context inference.", COLOR_ACCENT),
    ("Inference Throughput", "Memory-bound generation limits serving capacity. Every millisecond of latency translates directly to hardware cost at scale.", COLOR_HIGHLIGHT),
]
for i, (title, body, color) in enumerate(challenges):
    left = Inches(0.6 + i * 4.2)
    card = add_card(slide, left, Inches(1.8), Inches(3.9), Inches(3.8),
                    fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=color, line_width=Pt(1.5))
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.2), Inches(2.0), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.5),
                title, font_size=Pt(18), bold=True, font_color=color)
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.2), Inches(2.6), Inches(3.5), Inches(2.8),
                body, font_size=Pt(14), font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

# Bottom insight bar
insight = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                                  Inches(0.6), Inches(5.9), Inches(12.1), Inches(1.2))
insight.fill.solid()
insight.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x14, 0x1C, 0x24)
insight.line.color.rgb = COLOR_ACCENT
insight.line.width = Pt(1)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(6.05), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.9),
            "Core Insight  →  MoE sparsity + compressed attention can break the Pareto frontier: achieve higher quality at lower training and inference cost.",
            font_size=Pt(16), font_color=COLOR_TEXT, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 3: Architecture Overview
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "DeepSeek-V2 Architecture: MLA + DeepSeekMoE in a Transformer Block",
            font_size=Pt(32), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

# Architecture image
img_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, "figure_1.jpg")
if os.path.exists(img_path):
    slide.shapes.add_picture(img_path, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.3),
                             width=Inches(7.5))

# Legend / callout box on right
legend_card = add_card(slide, Inches(8.4), Inches(1.3), Inches(4.2), Inches(5.5),
                       fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.6), Inches(1.5), Inches(3.8), Inches(0.4),
            "Transformer Block Components", font_size=Pt(16), bold=True,
            font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

legend_items = [
    ("Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA)",
     "Replaces MHA with low-rank KV compression. Caches a compact latent vector instead of full K/V per head."),
    ("DeepSeekMoE FFN",
     "Shared experts + routed experts. Only a subset of 236B params are activated per token (21B)."),
    ("Decoupled RoPE",
     "Positional information injected via a separate key projection, preserving compression efficiency."),
]
for i, (lbl, desc) in enumerate(legend_items):
    y = Inches(2.1 + i * 1.5)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.6), y, Inches(3.8), Inches(0.35),
                "▸  " + lbl, font_size=Pt(14), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(8.8), y + Inches(0.35), Inches(3.6), Inches(0.9),
                desc, font_size=Pt(12), font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

# Bottom stats strip
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.9), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "Total Params: 236B  ·  Activated Params: 21B  ·  Context: 128K tokens  ·  Pre-training: 8.1T tokens",
            font_size=Pt(14), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 4: MLA Mechanism
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "Multi-Head Latent Attention Compresses KV Cache by 93.3%",
            font_size=Pt(32), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.05), Inches(12), Inches(0.35),
            "Better performance than MHA with dramatically less cache — strictly dominating GQA and MQA",
            font_size=Pt(15), font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

# Left: comparison image
img_path = os.path.join(ASSETS_DIR, "figure_2.jpg")
if os.path.exists(img_path):
    slide.shapes.add_picture(img_path, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.6),
                             width=Inches(6.8))

# Right: mechanism explanation
mech_card = add_card(slide, Inches(7.6), Inches(1.6), Inches(5.0), Inches(5.0),
                     fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(7.8), Inches(1.75), Inches(4.6), Inches(0.4),
            "How MLA Works", font_size=Pt(18), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

mla_bullets = [
    "Low-rank key-value joint compression: instead of caching full K and V vectors per head, MLA compresses them into a compact latent vector cₜᴷⱽ.",
    "During inference, only the latent vector is cached — full keys and values are reconstructed on-the-fly via learned projection matrices.",
    "A decoupled RoPE-based positional key is maintained separately, preserving positional information without inflating cache size.",
    "Result: 93.3% KV cache reduction vs. standard MHA, with superior downstream performance.",
]
for i, txt in enumerate(mla_bullets):
    y = Inches(2.35 + i * 0.85)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(7.8), y, Inches(4.6), Inches(0.75),
                "•  " + txt, font_size=Pt(13), font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

# Bottom comparison strip
comp = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                               Inches(0.6), Inches(6.8), Inches(12.1), Inches(0.5))
comp.fill.solid()
comp.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x14, 0x1C, 0x24)
comp.line.color.rgb = COLOR_HIGHLIGHT
comp.line.width = Pt(1)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(6.85), Inches(11.7), Inches(0.4),
            "MHA  →  high cache, best perf  |  GQA/MQA  →  lower cache, degraded perf  |  MLA  →  minimal cache, best perf",
            font_size=Pt(14), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 5: DeepSeekMoE
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "DeepSeekMoE: Fine-Grained Experts with Shared Expert Isolation",
            font_size=Pt(32), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.05), Inches(12), Inches(0.35),
            "Two expert types, device-limited routing, and auxiliary losses for load-balanced, communication-efficient training",
            font_size=Pt(15), font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

# Four component cards
moe_items = [
    ("Shared Experts (Ns)",
     "Always activated for every token. Capture common, high-frequency knowledge across the corpus, reducing redundant routing overhead.",
     COLOR_ACCENT2),
    ("Routed Experts (Nr)",
     "Sparsely activated via a top-Kr router. Fine-grained segmentation increases specialization potential — each expert masters a narrow domain.",
     COLOR_ACCENT),
    ("Device-Limited Routing",
     "Each token is constrained to experts on at most M devices. This bounds all-to-all communication overhead across GPU nodes.",
     COLOR_HIGHLIGHT),
    ("Load-Balancing Losses",
     "Auxiliary losses enforce balance across experts and devices. A token-dropping strategy during training prevents expert overflow without affecting inference.",
     COLOR_TEXT_DIM),
]
for i, (title, body, color) in enumerate(moe_items):
    col = i % 2
    row = i // 2
    left = Inches(0.6 + col * 6.2)
    top = Inches(1.6 + row * 2.6)
    card = add_card(slide, left, top, Inches(5.9), Inches(2.3),
                    fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=color, line_width=Pt(1.5))
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.2), top + Inches(0.15), Inches(5.5), Inches(0.4),
                title, font_size=Pt(17), bold=True, font_color=color)
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.2), top + Inches(0.55), Inches(5.5), Inches(1.6),
                body, font_size=Pt(14), font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

# Bottom stat
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.9), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "Result: 236B total parameters with only 21B activated per token — 11.2× parameter scaling at ~1/3 the active compute of a dense 70B model.",
            font_size=Pt(15), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, font_color=COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 6: Efficiency Gains (side-by-side comparison)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "42.5% Training Cost Reduction and 5.76× Generation Throughput vs. DeepSeek 67B",
            font_size=Pt(32), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.05), Inches(12), Inches(0.35),
            "Relative efficiency improvements of DeepSeek-V2 over its dense predecessor DeepSeek 67B",
            font_size=Pt(15), font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

# DeepSeek 67B column (left)
col1_x = Inches(1.0)
col_w = Inches(4.8)
row_h = Inches(1.3)
start_y = Inches(1.8)

# Header card for 67B
h1 = add_card(slide, col1_x, start_y, col_w, Inches(0.7),
              fill_color=RGBColor(0x20, 0x28, 0x30), line_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)
add_textbox(slide, col1_x, start_y + Inches(0.15), col_w, Inches(0.4),
            "DeepSeek 67B (Dense Baseline)", font_size=Pt(18), bold=True,
            align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

# Metric rows for 67B
metrics_67b = [
    ("Training Cost", "Baseline", COLOR_TEXT_DIM),
    ("KV Cache Size", "Baseline", COLOR_TEXT_DIM),
    ("Generation Throughput", "Baseline", COLOR_TEXT_DIM),
]
for i, (label, val, color) in enumerate(metrics_67b):
    y = start_y + Inches(0.9) + i * row_h
    card = add_card(slide, col1_x, y, col_w, Inches(1.15),
                    fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)
    add_textbox(slide, col1_x, y + Inches(0.1), col_w, Inches(0.35),
                label, font_size=Pt(14), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)
    add_textbox(slide, col1_x, y + Inches(0.45), col_w, Inches(0.5),
                val, font_size=Pt(24), bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                font_color=color)

# DeepSeek-V2 column (right)
col2_x = Inches(7.4)
h2 = add_card(slide, col2_x, start_y, col_w, Inches(0.7),
              fill_color=RGBColor(0x14, 0x24, 0x20), line_color=COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)
add_textbox(slide, col2_x, start_y + Inches(0.15), col_w, Inches(0.4),
            "DeepSeek-V2 (MoE + MLA)", font_size=Pt(18), bold=True,
            align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, font_color=COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)

metrics_v2 = [
    ("Training Cost", "−42.5%", COLOR_HIGHLIGHT,
     "Training a 236B-parameter MoE costs less than pre-training a 67B dense model."),
    ("KV Cache Size", "−93.3%", COLOR_ACCENT,
     "MLA compresses the KV cache to a tiny latent vector, unlocking long-context serving."),
    ("Generation Throughput", "5.76× higher", COLOR_ACCENT2,
     "Dramatically higher maximum throughput enables large-scale production deployment."),
]
for i, (label, val, color, desc) in enumerate(metrics_v2):
    y = start_y + Inches(0.9) + i * row_h
    card = add_card(slide, col2_x, y, col_w, Inches(1.15),
                    fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=color)
    add_textbox(slide, col2_x, y + Inches(0.05), col_w, Inches(0.3),
                label, font_size=Pt(14), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)
    add_textbox(slide, col2_x, y + Inches(0.32), col_w, Inches(0.45),
                val, font_size=Pt(26), bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                font_color=color)
    add_textbox(slide, col2_x, y + Inches(0.75), col_w, Inches(0.35),
                desc, font_size=Pt(11), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

# Arrows between columns
for i in range(3):
    y = start_y + Inches(0.9) + i * row_h + Inches(0.575) - Inches(0.15)
    arrow = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RIGHT_ARROW,
                                    Inches(5.9), y, Inches(1.4), Inches(0.3))
    arrow.fill.solid()
    arrow.fill.fore_color.rgb = COLOR_ACCENT
    arrow.line.fill.background()

# Bottom note
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.85), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "All metrics are relative improvements reported in the DeepSeek-V2 paper. No absolute FLOPs, cache sizes, or throughput numbers are stated.",
            font_size=Pt(12), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 7: MMLU Performance Comparison (scatter chart)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "DeepSeek-V2 Tops MMLU Among Open-Source Models at Only 21B Activated Parameters",
            font_size=Pt(30), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.05), Inches(12), Inches(0.35),
            "Pareto-optimal positioning: highest MMLU score with the fewest activated parameters",
            font_size=Pt(15), font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

# Build XY scatter chart: X = Activated Params (B), Y = MMLU Score
chart_data = XyChartData()

series_data = [
    ("DeepSeek-V2", [(21, 78.5)], COLOR_HIGHLIGHT),
    ("LLaMA 3 70B", [(70, 77.0)], COLOR_ACCENT2),
    ("Mixtral 8×22B", [(39, 77.6)], COLOR_ACCENT),
    ("Qwen1.5 72B", [(72, 75.6)], RGBColor(0xFF, 0xD7, 0x00)),
    ("DeepSeek 67B", [(67, 73.0)], COLOR_TEXT_DIM),
    ("LLaMA 2 70B", [(70, 69.0)], RGBColor(0x88, 0x88, 0x88)),
    ("Mixtral 8×7B", [(13, 70.6)], RGBColor(0x66, 0x99, 0xCC)),
    ("LLaMA 3 8B", [(8, 65.0)], RGBColor(0xAA, 0xAA, 0xAA)),
]

for name, points, color in series_data:
    series = chart_data.add_series(name)
    for x, y in points:
        series.add_data_point(x, y)

chart = slide.shapes.add_chart(
    XL_CHART_TYPE.XY_SCATTER,
    Inches(0.6), Inches(1.6), Inches(8.0), Inches(5.2),
    chart_data
).chart

chart.has_legend = True
chart.legend.position = XL_LEGEND_POSITION.RIGHT
chart.legend.include_in_layout = True

# Style the plot area
plot = chart.plots[0]
plot.has_data_labels = False

# Axis formatting
chart.category_axis.tick_labels.font.size = Pt(11)
chart.value_axis.tick_labels.font.size = Pt(11)
chart.category_axis.tick_labels.font.color.rgb = COLOR_TEXT_DIM
chart.value_axis.tick_labels.font.color.rgb = COLOR_TEXT_DIM

# Axis titles
chart.category_axis.axis_title.text_frame.text = "Activated Parameters (B)"
chart.category_axis.axis_title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(12)
chart.category_axis.axis_title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = COLOR_TEXT_DIM

chart.value_axis.axis_title.text_frame.text = "MMLU Score"
chart.value_axis.axis_title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.size = Pt(12)
chart.value_axis.axis_title.text_frame.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb = COLOR_TEXT_DIM

# Set marker sizes and colors
for i, (name, points, color) in enumerate(series_data):
    series = chart.series[i]
    series.marker.size = 12
    series.marker.style = 2  # circle
    series.format.line.fill.background()
    series.format.fill.solid()
    series.format.fill.fore_color.rgb = color

# Right-side callout box
callout = add_card(slide, Inches(8.8), Inches(1.6), Inches(3.8), Inches(5.2),
                   fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(9.0), Inches(1.8), Inches(3.4), Inches(0.4),
            "Why This Matters", font_size=Pt(16), bold=True,
            font_color=COLOR_HIGHLIGHT)

callout_bullets = [
    "DeepSeek-V2 achieves the highest MMLU score (78.5) in this comparison.",
    "It does so with only 21B activated parameters — 3.3× fewer than LLaMA 3 70B and 1.9× fewer than Mixtral 8×22B.",
    "This is a clear Pareto improvement: better quality at lower active compute.",
    "Dense models like LLaMA 2 70B and DeepSeek 67B are dominated on both axes.",
]
for i, txt in enumerate(callout_bullets):
    y = Inches(2.4 + i * 1.1)
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(9.0), y, Inches(3.4), Inches(1.0),
                "•  " + txt, font_size=Pt(13), font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

# Bottom note
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.95), Inches(12), Inches(0.35),
            "Data sourced from the DeepSeek-V2 paper (arXiv:2405.04434). MMLU scores are 5-shot averages where applicable.",
            font_size=Pt(12), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 8: Alignment Results
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) Rivals Closed-Source Models on Chinese Benchmarks",
            font_size=Pt(30), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.05), Inches(12), Inches(0.35),
            "Post-training: SFT on 1.5M conversational sessions + GRPO-based Reinforcement Learning",
            font_size=Pt(15), font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

# Three benchmark cards
bench_data = [
    ("AlpacaEval 2.0", "38.9%", "Length-controlled win rate",
     "Competitive in English open-ended evaluation against strong open-source chat models.",
     COLOR_ACCENT2),
    ("MT-Bench", "8.97", "Overall score",
     "Strong generalist conversation quality across diverse instruction-following tasks.",
     COLOR_ACCENT),
    ("AlignBench (Chinese)", "7.91", "Overall score",
     "Outperforms all open-source models and most closed-source models in Chinese alignment quality.",
     COLOR_HIGHLIGHT),
]
for i, (name, score, sub, desc, color) in enumerate(bench_data):
    left = Inches(0.6 + i * 4.2)
    card = add_card(slide, left, Inches(1.7), Inches(3.9), Inches(3.6),
                    fill_color=COLOR_CARD_BG, line_color=color, line_width=Pt(1.5))
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.2), Inches(1.85), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.35),
                name, font_size=Pt(16), bold=True, font_color=color,
                align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.2), Inches(2.3), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.6),
                score, font_size=Pt(36), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT,
                align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.2), Inches(2.85), Inches(3.5), Inches(0.3),
                sub, font_size=Pt(12), font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM,
                align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    add_textbox(slide, left + Inches(0.2), Inches(3.25), Inches(3.5), Inches(1.8),
                desc, font_size=Pt(13), font_color=COLOR_TEXT,
                align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

# Bottom insight
insight2 = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
                                   Inches(0.6), Inches(5.6), Inches(12.1), Inches(1.4))
insight2.fill.solid()
insight2.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(0x14, 0x1C, 0x24)
insight2.line.color.rgb = COLOR_HIGHLIGHT
insight2.line.width = Pt(1)
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.8), Inches(5.75), Inches(11.7), Inches(1.1),
            "Key Result  →  DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) is the strongest open-source chat model in Chinese and competitive with closed-source systems in English. "
            "The alignment pipeline (SFT + GRPO) demonstrates that architectural efficiency gains translate directly into high-quality conversational models.",
            font_size=Pt(15), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Slide 9: Takeaways
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
set_slide_bg(slide, COLOR_BG)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(0.4), Inches(12), Inches(0.7),
            "Key Takeaways: Architectural Innovation Unlocks Efficient Scaling",
            font_size=Pt(32), bold=True, font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(1.05), Inches(12), Inches(0.35),
            "DeepSeek-V2 demonstrates that the performance–cost Pareto frontier is not fixed",
            font_size=Pt(15), font_color=COLOR_ACCENT)

takeaways = [
    ("MLA is a strictly better attention mechanism",
     "Achieves superior performance to standard MHA while reducing KV cache by 93.3%. It dominates GQA and MQA on both quality and efficiency.",
     COLOR_ACCENT),
    ("DeepSeekMoE enables economical training at massive scale",
     "A 236B-parameter MoE trains at 42.5% lower cost than a 67B dense model, thanks to fine-grained experts, shared expert isolation, and efficient routing.",
     COLOR_HIGHLIGHT),
    ("Top-tier performance with minimal activated compute",
     "Only 21B activated parameters match or exceed 70B-class dense models on MMLU — a clear Pareto-optimal result.",
     COLOR_ACCENT2),
    ("Strong multilingual alignment",
     "DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) leads open-source models in Chinese (AlignBench 7.91) and is competitive in English open-ended evaluation.",
     COLOR_TEXT_DIM),
    ("Practical deployment advantages",
     "5.76× generation throughput improvement and 93.3% KV cache reduction make DeepSeek-V2 practical for large-scale production serving.",
     COLOR_ACCENT),
]

for i, (title, body, color) in enumerate(takeaways):
    y = Inches(1.6 + i * 1.05)
    # Number circle
    circle = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, Inches(0.7), y + Inches(0.05),
                                    Inches(0.35), Inches(0.35))
    circle.fill.solid()
    circle.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    circle.line.fill.background()
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.7), y + Inches(0.08), Inches(0.35), Inches(0.3),
                str(i + 1), font_size=Pt(14), bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER,
                font_color=COLOR_BG)
    # Title
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.2), y, Inches(11.2), Inches(0.35),
                title, font_size=Pt(17), bold=True, font_color=color)
    # Body
    add_textbox(slide, Inches(1.2), y + Inches(0.32), Inches(11.2), Inches(0.6),
                body, font_size=Pt(14), font_color=COLOR_TEXT)

# Bottom bar
add_textbox(slide, Inches(0.6), Inches(6.85), Inches(12), Inches(0.4),
            "Paper: arXiv:2405.04434  ·  Model: DeepSeek-V2  ·  236B total / 21B activated / 128K context",
            font_size=Pt(13), align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER, font_color=COLOR_TEXT_DIM)

# ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
prs.save(OUTPUT_PATH)
print(f"Saved presentation to {OUTPUT_PATH}")
